chosen_root.file: crates/kria-core/src/memory/api.rs (struct at :171; single constructor path assemble at :267; DB-injection entry open_with_db at :216)
chosen_root.rationale: MemorySystem is already self-declared as 'the memory system composition root and public API' and is the closest existing structure to design §19.1's single kria-core::memory composition owner. It already (1) owns the single Arc<Database> authority handle and vends it via database(); (2) owns the governed WritePolicy, the live Retriever, ModeManager, the SlowPath blocking worker + its spawned task, the shared AnnVectorStore, and the embedder as struct fields; (3) constructs every store port (Event/Relational/Vector/Search/RetrievalWeight) in one place (assemble); (4) builds Lifecycle and the CognitiveScheduler (with its jobs) on demand, threading self.db/self.write_policy into background cognition; and (5) ALREADY demonstrates the 'inject one database handle' pattern via open_with_db (the seed for 1.2.3). Evolving it means promoting assemble() into the design's `memory::composition` module and routing adapters through it — an incremental consolidation rather than a greenfield rewrite. By contrast, KriaMemoryRuntime (runtime_backend.rs) is a legacy runtime-trait backend over migration-0005 competing tables (memory_facts/snippets/document_chunks) that merely happens to open the DB first on desktop; it should be folded behind the single root and its facts surface is a cutover/deletion target (F1.9), not the root to evolve.

why_not_alternatives.KriaMemoryRuntime: Legacy runtime-compat facts/snippets/document-chunk orchestrator (competing authority CA-1/CA-3); narrower than MemorySystem; would require rebuilding the cognitive graph it lacks.
why_not_alternatives.build_new_root: Rejected — MemorySystem already contains ~all of the owned services; a greenfield root would duplicate assemble() and increase cutover risk for a single-dev pre-production codebase (dev-context: prefer incremental reuse).
why_not_alternatives.adapter-level_root_(runtime.rs): Rejected — an adapter must not own domain SQL/store construction (design §19.1); the current adapter-level wiring is exactly the violation this gate consolidates.

evolution_plan_refs.action: Introduce validated value objects (RecordId/EventId/InvocationId/PolicyPartition/GraphRevision/UtcTimestamp/ValidInterval/IdempotencyKey/schema-version) so boundaries stop passing raw unchecked strings.

Define narrow authority command/query/outbox/integrity ports in kria-core; inject exactly ONE Database handle + configuration + blocking-worker/scheduler into the MemorySystem-derived composition module (collapse the open/open_with_embedder vs open_with_db split into one injected entry).

Wire desktop (runtime.rs) and server (main.rs) startup to the SAME core root; adapters receive ports/handles (ConversationStore, MemoryManager surface) from the root instead of constructing Database/ConversationStore; preserve distinct authenticated caller construction at the adapter boundary; retire the redundant MemoryConfig.db_path ownership.
